# P2a code quality runtime addendum

Verdict: **FAIL**. The owner quality gate remains failed until strict repository
Clippy actually passes. The previous source-only PASS and its files are preserved.
That review missed this test clone; the runtime diagnostic takes precedence.

At Source `a418947fcacd49c259a83cfc7c9a7c640552117c`,
`./script/clippy --locked -p android_tools` exits **101**. Its actual
release/all-targets/all-features invocation reports one error,
`clippy::redundant_clone`, at `crates/android_tools/tests/import_facts.rs:745`.
The raw log SHA-256 is
`f732c9e998be247590591a3293d3980c373382c17543bf59c9bab2d0d36f5b3f`.
Before/after source guard files are byte-identical and bind 4,743 source files.

The exact proposed fix is a single move-only change in
`absent_observation_round_trip_does_not_become_bare_null`:

```rust
// Before
let mut value = fixture.value.clone();
// Proposed
let mut value = fixture.value;
```

This test never uses another `fixture` field afterward. The fixture has no custom
`Drop` implementation, so moving its JSON field is valid; its remaining TempDir
field remains alive until test-scope exit. Catalogue mutation, the subsequent
clone of the borrowed project, and all existing assertions stay byte-identical.
No assertion, test, lint setting or error check should be removed or weakened.
The proposed edit has not been applied or compiled.

The retained current-source receipts and raw log hashes independently confirm
291 passing tests across 10 groups, zero failures/ignored tests, a passing normal
all-feature library build and passing formatting. These successful checks do not
override the required Clippy failure.

The owner reports that all three product-fix rounds are used and Root escalation
has been sent. This addendum does not authorize another edit or reset that count.
After any authorized fix, actual affected tests and strict repository Clippy must
pass on the final source, with refreshed required source guards and review
evidence. No compiler, Cargo, formatter, JVM, Gradle or native command was run by
this reviewer; no source, index, Git history or runtime cache was changed.

Companion JSON records exact hashes, the diagnostic, preserved prior reports and
a virtual candidate hash. Original reference-test credit remains zero.
